name: Millet Tomato Bath
category: Healthy Rice, Millet and Grain Dishes
ingredients: ½ tsp each mustard seeds and urad dal
1 tsp bisibele bath or sambar powder
¼ cup split moong dal, rinsed
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the mustard, and fry the urad dal until golden. Add curry leaves and chilli.
Add the onion and ginger-garlic paste and cook for 4 minutes. Add the tomatoes, turmeric and masala and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the millet, water and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes until soft and slightly mushy.
Cook the moong dal together with the millet.
note: A Karnataka-style one-pot dish with a soft, porridge-like texture.
